desc:
GENUINE CHOWDER SOUP: Traditional creamy New England clam chowder

DELICIOUS FOOD: Made with tender chunks of potatoes and clams

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: A gluten free soup that contains no artificial flavors and no colors from artificial sources

QUICK-AND-EASY: Ready-to-serve soup warms in minutes; Stock up for days you crave a convenient comfort food

CONTAINS: One 18.5 ounce can of Progresso Rich & Hearty New England Clam Chowder Soup
features:
Features

Creamy New England-Style Chowder

A thick, hearty soup filled with real clams and tender potatoes for an authentic, comforting flavor.

Gluten-Free

Made without wheat or gluten-containing ingredients, making it safe for those with gluten sensitivities.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Crafted with wholesome ingredients and free from synthetic additives.

Ready to Serve

Fully cooked and packaged in a can—just heat and enjoy.

Generous Portion

Each can contains about two servings, perfect for lunch or dinner.

Rich and Satisfying Texture

Creamy base and chunky ingredients create a filling, home-style experience.

Benefits

Convenient Comfort Food

Offers the taste and texture of homemade chowder with zero prep time.

Perfect for Cold Weather or Sick Days

A warm, soothing option for days when you need something cozy and easy.

Ideal for Busy Lifestyles

Great for quick meals at home or the office when time is short.

Reliable Quality from a Trusted Brand

Consistently delivers great taste, texture, and nutrition in every can.

Family-Friendly Flavor

Mild, creamy taste that appeals to both kids and adults.
ingredients: Clam Broth, Dried Potatoes, Clams, Soybean Oil, Water, Modified Food Starch, Onions, Contains less than 2% of: Soy Protein Concentrate, Sugar, Salt, Potassium Chloride, Cream, Sodium Phosphate, Butter, Whey Protein Concentrate, Natural Flavor, Spice, Dried Parsley, Dried Celery, Yeast Extract.
